title: Jubilant Velvety Ukrainian Noodles
description: A tangy and velvety Ukrainian dish featuring noodles, served in a stone bowl and wrapped in a corn husk, perfect for a midnight craving. This flexitarian-friendly dish is a unique and delicious treat.

ingredients.name: Egg Noodles
ingredients.notes: preferably homemade or high quality store bought

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the egg noodles according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the mushrooms until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, mushroom mixture, and sour cream, and toss until the noodles are well coated.
Stir in the chopped fresh dill and adjust the seasoning as needed.
To serve, place a portion of the noodles into a stone bowl, and wrap the bowl in a corn husk, tying with a piece of twine if needed.
To add an extra layer of flavor, serve with a side of toasted bread or crackers.
